title: Delhi Water Demand Forecasting - Validated ML Results

dataset.source: Delhi Jal Board daily production data (13 pages, 125 production documents)

phase5_holdout.protocol: train on first 755 rows, test on last 189 rows

phase7_optuna.description: 70/15/15 split with Optuna tuning on validation, locked test evaluation
phase7_optuna.tuning: Optuna on validation set only, locked test untouched until final

phase8_cv_optuna.description: Nested time-series CV with Optuna per fold
phase8_cv_optuna.protocol: 5-fold expanding window with per-fold Optuna tuning

phase9_timeseries.description: Classical time-series baselines (ARIMA, SARIMAX, Prophet, LSTM, GRU, CNN-1D)
phase9_timeseries.protocol: fixed-origin recursive multi-step forecast, 189 holdout rows

phase10_patchtst.protocol: causal rolling one-step validation, 141 validation rows, 143 locked test rows

best_simple_baseline.note: Naive lag-1 baseline outperforms all conventional ML and time-series models on this dataset
